say:1:1423465001:1.text: A dwarf merchant named Ruack came to me recently with an idea to open a tourist route in Sal'thorin, centered on the ruins of Helthor's temple.
say:1:1423465001:1.source_cn: 前不久有位名叫达克的矮人商人向我提出，想在萨洛克兰开辟...

say:2:1423465002:1.text: It sounds like a win-win to me, so I've agreed to the partnership.
say:2:1423465002:1.source_cn: 在我看来，双方都能从中获益……我已经同意了这项合作。

say:3:1423465003:1.text: But it seems like Ruack's run into trouble setting things up. He's near the <style="highlight">Arcane Lift</style>. Can you help him out?
